name: RKEC Projects Ltd
tagline: Nano-cap civil EPC contractor in severe financial distress — loss-making (ROE -19.4%), 75.2% promoter pledge, 262-day debtors cycle, and 70% one-year price collapse — thesis fit 'neither', conviction Low.
business_overview: RKEC Projects Ltd (NSE: RKEC, incorporated 2005) is a small civil-construction and engineering-procurement-contracting (EPC) company specializing in industrial, marine, bridge, and defense-infrastructure projects. The company is classified as a 'Super Special Class' civil contractor (Super Class designation). Primary revenue driver: winning and executing mid-sized infrastructure construction contracts. Seeded via untrusted X channel (@rajuidesai, high-conviction bear call on 2026-08-15: 'dismal result', directionally corroborated by balance-sheet stress findings).
fundamentals_narrative: RKEC is in acute financial distress despite still operating as a going concern. FY2026 TTM revenues of Rs 121 Cr represent a sharp decline from the Rs 399 Cr peak in FY2024, falling -70% in just two years. More critically, the company swung from Rs 8.35 profit per share (Mar 2025) to -Rs 13.44 per share (Mar 2026) — a total collapse in profitability. ROE stands at -19.4% and ROCE at -5.54%, both deeply negative and indicative of value destruction. Working-capital management is in crisis: debtors have surged to 262 days (up from 154 days in Mar 2024), signaling severe collection delays and liquidity stress. Promoters having pledged 75.2% of their holding is a red-flag distress signal — typically preceding forced-sale/margin-call risk independent of operating fundamentals. Borrowings have grown while profit evaporated, raising solvency concerns. The combination of revenue collapse, profitability inversion, liquidity crunch, and promoter distress makes this a HIGH CAUTION / potential AVOID territory.
